questions.question: Does clipping gradients before Adam guarantee that final updates obey the same norm threshold?
options: Yes, every later transformation preserves that bound
Only if the loss is a scalar
questions.explanation: The clipping threshold bounds the incoming gradient. Adam’s stateful rescaling and learning rate determine the final update.
optionFeedback: Adam rescales coordinates using its moment estimates after clipping. Inspect the norm of the actual parameter delta separately.
The clipping threshold bounds the incoming gradient. Adam’s stateful rescaling and learning rate determine the final update.
A scalar loss can have a large or poorly scaled gradient. Compute the gradient norm and update norm rather than inferring them from loss shape.
